One physician, a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident with a saved pre-round and no note (rawPreRoundNotes seeded equal to preRoundNotes; the matrix seed leaves it out, and then Generate refuses with 'edited after it was last processed'); spec newspec-c/flt-tc17-s19-note-fail.spec.ts. Every ai/notes:generateNote attempt fails at the socket. Judged 20/21. Fail (known B27): Hospital Post-Round still shows the disabled 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner 10 s after the failure (the chart stays 'seen', never note-ready). Pass: Post-Round in both contexts says 'No note generated yet.' with no note, no SUBJECTIVE / SNF FOLLOW-UP, no Copy to EMR or Copy Assessment & Plan; Nursing Home Post-Round has no spinner and nothing of the Hospital chart; the Nursing Home Encounter tab shows 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; no note stored; after a reload the typed dictation is on Encounter and in encounterNotes in both contexts. Recorded, D7 / Q5 (wording and place): Post-Round never says 'not generated' and names no retry — it says 'Complete the Encounter tab first.'; Encounter says 'couldn’t be generated'. Recorded, Q13: Hospital offers no 'Mark Encounter Complete' (the spinner button instead); Nursing Home shows 'Mark Visit Complete' disabled. RG-DIAG: one client generateNote call per chart (the server's retries are not exercised by a socket failure).
Product issue: After a failed note generation on a Hospital chart, Post-Round shows a 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner that never ends under 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.'

testCase.name: [local] S19 Forced note failure on charts with no note, both contexts: Post-Round says 'Note not generated' with what to do next and nothing to copy; the dictation survives a reload

descriptionHtml:
Bug B27 · P2 · new (partly known)

Failure states give the wrong or no guidance: after an interrupted pre-round save the Encounter tab keeps the physician waiting for the panels while the Pre-Round tab says to tap Save Note; an interrupted Nursing Home Save Note says the text was edited; a red 'disconnected' error stays after dictation recovered; a failed Quick Dictation transcription shows only the raw server error, no '⚠ what to do'; with the microphone blocked it still says 'Dictation done — review before saving'; Post-Round shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' forever for a Hospital patient with no note yet

Tickets: TFA-94745 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-94745/92582): EFS/S06: the Encounter tab does say the panels are still being processed; the fault is that the processing had stopped. TC-04/S28: on a 429 the only thing on screen is the raw server error (B17's kind), and S28 covers only the batch (whisper) path, not a gpt-live failure. EFS/S22: 'Dictation done' with the microphone blocked (UAT state 8). EFS/S02 and TC-20/S24: the endless 'Finalizing…' spinner D7 points to.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S06, TC-10/S29, TC-23/S08, TC-04/S28, EFS/S17

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S19 Forced note failure on charts with no note, both contexts: Post-Round says 'Note not generated' with what to do next and nothing to copy; the dictation survives a reload

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T8a Note generation failed, Encounter side (TFA-94745 state 4): the typed dictation is kept, also after a reload, and an explicit message says the note was not generated and what to do next (retry), in H … (TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 6; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T8b Note generation failed, Post-Round side (TFA-94745 state 4): the Note tab says the note was not generated ('Note not generated') and what to do next, not the plain 'No note generated yet' empty card; … (TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 6; UAT Empty & Failure States)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident with a saved pre-round and no note yet; every ai/notes:generateNote attempt fails (local stack only)

When Hospital: type the dictation on Encounter, tap Generate Note & Finish and wait until the screen settles (up to 60 s); open Post-Round (cp1); reload and open Encounter (cp2). Nursing Home: type the dictation, Generate, wait; Encounter as it is (cp3); Post-Round (cp4); reload and open Encounter (cp5)

Then Post-Round says the note was not generated and what to do next (retry), shows no note, no Copy to EMR or Copy Assessment & Plan, and no 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' once settled; the Nursing Home Encounter tab shows a failure message with a retry; the typed dictation is on Encounter after a reload in both contexts. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint. reqs are ungated, so a fabricated note, a copy control, a stuck 'Finalizing', a missing retry or a lost dictation is a plain Fail. The literal 'not generated' is a knownGap (Q5), so main reports Fail (known) until Q5 is answered. The failure runs on charts with no earlier note; a failure over an existing note is S27. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

Forced note failure on charts with no note, both contexts: Post-Round says 'Note not generated' with what to do next and nothing to copy; the dictation survives a reload

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

Detail:

One physician, a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident with a saved pre-round and no note (rawPreRoundNotes seeded equal to preRoundNotes; the matrix seed leaves it out, and then Generate refuses with 'edited after it was last processed'); spec newspec-c/flt-tc17-s19-note-fail.spec.ts. Every ai/notes:generateNote attempt fails at the socket. Judged 20/21. Fail (known B27): Hospital Post-Round still shows the disabled 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner 10 s after the failure (the chart stays 'seen', never note-ready). Pass: Post-Round in both contexts says 'No note generated yet.' with no note, no SUBJECTIVE / SNF FOLLOW-UP, no Copy to EMR or Copy Assessment & Plan; Nursing Home Post-Round has no spinner and nothing of the Hospital chart; the Nursing Home Encounter tab shows 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; no note stored; after a reload the typed dictation is on Encounter and in encounterNotes in both contexts. Recorded, D7 / Q5 (wording and place): Post-Round never says 'not generated' and names no retry — it says 'Complete the Encounter tab first.'; Encounter says 'couldn’t be generated'. Recorded, Q13: Hospital offers no 'Mark Encounter Complete' (the spinner button instead); Nursing Home shows 'Mark Visit Complete' disabled. RG-DIAG: one client generateNote call per chart (the server's retries are not exercised by a socket failure).

Product issue: After a failed note generation on a Hospital chart, Post-Round shows a 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner that never ends under 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.'

Known gap (known): true

Evidence: 7 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-ai. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
